decisions: Actual source viewport/inner-track/slide identity remains distinct; Embla owns track transform and snap positions. Source 16px slide gutters map to native selected horizontal specimen 165px height and 28px full-round controls. Reference chooses one complete slide per snap; native multi-card samples remain evidence, not forced runtime widths. Controls are placed in reserved 40px internal lanes so320px views retain both navigation controls; this explicitly differs from source external 48px offsets. Vertical reference uses 240px constrained viewport and top/bottom control lanes; orientation is forwarded to Embla axis, while caller data-orientation binds visual CSS because wrapper emits no orientation attribute. Actual source capture still intercepts Left/Right in both orientations, not Up/Down, and does not exclude editable descendants; chosen slides contain no editable controls. RTL passes Embla opts.direction and HTML dir; Left still invokes scrollPrev and Right scrollNext per pinned wrapper, rather than invented physical-key reversal. Button source default outline/icon-sm is retained with native 28px circle override. External status is caller setApi select/reInit state, not an upstream onIndexChange API. No autoplay, fake slide tabindex, automatic focus movement or undocumented pause behavior.

Semantic token scalar values are meaningful reusable metrics, never coordinate-keyed specimen dimensions. Widths in native specimen grids remain evidence unless explicitly adopted as a domain layout constraint.
